purpose: Local evaluation notes for app-layer overlays. Not a certification freeze and not an NVIDIA L40 claim.

overlays.auto_trim: Detects camera cuts and keeps the longest grass-visible segment before the frozen pipeline runs.
overlays.multiframe_geometry: If the Stage-7 anchor frame has no valid PnLCalib pose, retry nearby frames and rebind the homography to the original frame_idx.
overlays.team_assignment_v3: Runtime overlay on frozen V1 relative-team summary: ignore short-track colour ties and break remaining ties by nearest cluster mean.
overlays.goal_end_v3: After Stage 13, if the chosen pitch end is >=45 m and the other end is <=35 m, flip to the near goal before shot geometry and xG.

clips.notes: Certified local Cell-40 regression. Overlays should be no-ops if the clip has no cuts, the anchor calibrates, and jerseys are not tied.
Fewer than four canonical ball rows. Auto-trim cannot invent ball detections.

clips.expected_without_overlay: tied modal appearance cluster at Stage 12
clips.expected_with_team_assignment_v3: may COMPLETE if the only ties were short tracks or breakable by nearest centre
clips.notes: Striped Barcelona kit is the motivating case for the team overlay.

clips.expected_without_overlay: NO_VALID_GEOMETRY, often because a celebration camera cut follows the shot
clips.expected_with_auto_trim: celebration cut removed; calibration may still fail at 480p
clips.expected_with_multiframe_geometry: nearby-frame retry if the anchor is blurred
clips.expected_without_goal_end_v3: target RIGHT, ~92 m, xG ~0.5% (far pitch end)
clips.expected_with_goal_end_v3: flip to LEFT, ~12.5 m, much higher xG
clips.notes: Liverpool vs Manchester City, 854x480, ~10.6s with a hard cut to celebration at ~5.2s. Frozen Stage 13 can pick the far pitch end.
